visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two creators sit at a wooden table in a brightly lit indoor venue decorated with festive lattice lights and a Santa figurine. A pile of gray blind boxes sits between them. The woman, wearing a blue jersey and colorful necklace, speaks excitedly with wide eyes while the man in a red jacket smiles. (2) The woman picks up a gray box and tears into it, removing a silver inner bag. She reveals a round red plush toy with a simple face and a small stem. They both look at the toy with joyful expressions, the man laughing heartily. (3) The man tears open another box. He pulls out a pink round plush toy. Both creators erupt into laughter, the woman covering her mouth and then clapping her hands while leaning away in surprise. (4) A third box is opened, revealing a green round plush toy. The woman holds it close to the camera, showcasing its small red eyes and simple mouth. They continue their lively conversation while gesturing toward the toys. (5) They open the remaining boxes, finding duplicates. They hold up two pink plushies and two red ones side-by-side, comparing them. The woman smiles broadly, pointing at the toys as they speak to the camera. (6) The video ends with a close-up of the green plushie held in front of the lens. The creators are visible in the background, waving and smiling warmly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-arousal female voice speaks rapidly in Mandarin with a bright, professional tone. A medium-arousal male voice responds calmly. The BGM is a moderate-tempo acoustic pop track with clear guitar strumming. (2) A distinct percussive rustling sound occurs as cardboard is torn. This is followed by the crinkling of a plastic bag. The female voice rises in pitch and intensity as she identifies the item. (3) Loud, high-arousal laughter from both speakers fills the mix. The female voice exhibits high pitch variability and rapid speech patterns. The BGM continues steadily in the background. (4) Another sharp tearing sound of cardboard occurs. This is immediately followed by a sustained, high-pitched scream of excitement from the female speaker and loud, rhythmic hand clapping. (5) The male voice speaks with a humorous, teased tone while the female voice remains highly animated. The sound of plastic bag rustling persists as more boxes are opened. (6) The female voice lowers slightly in arousal but maintains a friendly, narrative tone. The BGM remains consistent. A final sharp 'Ah!' exclamation occurs during a duplicate reveal. (7) The audio concludes with a clear call-to-action delivered with high articulation clarity as the BGM fades out.
